//: The tsconfig the scheduled jobs are run with on the server.
//why: `tsx` resolves `$lib/x` through tsconfig paths. The repository's own
tsconfig.json extends ./.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json, which is generated by
a build and is not deployed — so on the box tsx had no idea what `$lib`
was and the reminders job died on `Cannot find package '$lib'`, having
survived two earlier attempts at the same class of failure.
This file is the deployed directory's whole tsconfig: the one alias the
jobs need, and nothing about compiling, because nothing there compiles.
